prompt: As a code reviewer, generate the test automation coding standards for this Playwright project and then review the contact tests (tests/contact/contact.spec.ts) against those standards.

assertions.name: standards-file-created
assertions.description: TEST_AUTOMATION_STANDARDS.md is produced in the outputs

assertions.name: standards-has-review-checklist
assertions.description: Standards document includes a Code Review Checklist section

assertions.name: standards-covers-all-layers
assertions.description: Standards doc covers page objects, fixtures, assertions, waits, and test data

assertions.name: review-findings-produced
assertions.description: A review findings report is produced for contact.spec.ts

assertions.name: review-uses-severity-groups
assertions.description: Review findings are grouped by HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW severity

assertions.name: review-cross-references-standards
assertions.description: Review findings reference the standards document sections or rules
